title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Ordering Conditions: One Vendor Item per Order
content:
**Condition.** A customer of Ridgeline Special Order Services may hold any number of special orders at the same time; there is no limit on the number of special orders per customer. Each special order is one vendor item ordered for one customer. An order whose order total is below the order minimum of its program is not placed.

## The same condition, by part

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Number of orders a customer may hold | no limit |
| What one order covers | one vendor item, for one customer |
| Order total below the program's order minimum | the order is not placed |

The program's order minimum is the figure shown for that program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services program schedule of order minimums.

## Examples (hypothetical orders)

- A customer remodelling a kitchen orders semi-custom cabinets and a fabricated countertop: these are two special orders, one per vendor item, and the customer may hold both, together with any other special orders already open.
- An order total below the program's order minimum is not placed. An order total equal to or above the minimum is not barred by this condition.
